workflows.name: Forensic walkthrough map
steps: 1. Show me every parameter that governs decisions.
2. Prove the running system uses these and nothing else.
3. Show me a decision and the policy that produced it.
4. Prove that record hasn't been altered.
5. Change a parameter and show me the system notice.

3. Bump the cassette version (config and parameter set).
4. Run the suite - validation and the scanner enforce the rest.

risks.text: Unintelligible, unparseable, or malformed governor response must be treated as a REFUSAL, never an approval, and the harness must never run ungoverned-but-report-success when a governed decision was required.
Non-JSON governor output -> blocked (safety_check fails closed on bad json)
Empty/unintelligible response -> blocked (safety_check fails closed on empty content)
'safe' not a bool -> blocked (Gate 1 fails closed on nonbool safe)
Client raises -> blocked, error captured (safety_check fails closed on transport error)
No fabricated target (decide_healing_bounds fails closed no fabricated target)
Governance required but no governor -> blocked (harness fails closed when no governor)
Missing required parameter keys, type mismatches, inverted ranges, missing metadata slots, identity mismatch, or drift between parameter set and derived views cause a CassetteValidationError.
Any transport/client failure is converted to (None, err) so the caller can fail closed instead of raising through the pipeline.

notes.text: The rule (Item #3): the cassette is the single authoritative source of truth for every governance parameter in Sentinel OS. No governance value is hardcoded anywhere in production, simulation, or test code.
Loading a cassette IS validating it; an invalid cassette fails loudly with the complete violation list, and there are no fallback defaults anywhere in the system.
The three metadata slots (approval_date, justification, last_reviewed) are required to be present and non-empty on every parameter.
There is no partial load, no warning-and-continue, no default substitution. A system that cannot prove its policy does not start.
Governance values are read at decision time, not cached at startup: swapping the cassette changes behavior on the very next decision.
Gate 1 -- the LLM boundary. Nothing leaves this class as a trustworthy decision unless the governor's output parsed AND validated.
